analysis.title: Rates Outlook 2027: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
key_insights: ING names three forces shaping long-end rates in 2027: AI-driven productivity (the 'good'), elevated fiscal deficits (the 'bad') and renewed inflationary pressure from ongoing wars (the 'ugly').
ING expects things to look less 'ugly' by the middle of 2027 as inflation falls.
risk_factors: Elevated fiscal deficits push up long-end rates.
Renewed inflationary pressure from ongoing wars.
geopolitical: Ongoing wars are cited as a source of renewed inflationary pressure on long-end rates.
contextual_mentions: AI-driven productivity as a force on long-end rates
Elevated fiscal deficits weighing on long-end rates
Inflation expected to fall by mid-2027
